mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_teacher_tool_category WHERE status='0' AND del_flag='0' ORDER BY sort_order, category_id

SELECT t.*, r.category_id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c2.category_name ORDER BY c2.sort_order, c2.category_id SEPARATOR '、') FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r2 JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c2 ON c2.category_id=r2.category_id WHERE r2.tool_id=t.tool_id AND c2.status='0' AND c2.del_flag='0') AS category_name_text FROM biz_teacher_tool t JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r ON r.tool_id=t.tool_id JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c ON c.category_id=r.category_id WHERE t.status='0' AND t.del_flag='0' AND c.status='0' AND c.del_flag='0' ORDER BY r.category_id, t.sort_order, t.tool_id

SELECT t.* FROM biz_teacher_tool t WHERE t.status='0' AND t.del_flag='0' AND t.is_recommended='Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c ON c.category_id=r.category_id WHERE r.tool_id=t.tool_id AND c.status='0' AND c.del_flag='0' ) ORDER BY t.recommend_order, t.sort_order, t.tool_id

SELECT k.task_code, k.task_name, k.description, k.sort_order, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tool_id) AS tool_count FROM biz_teacher_tool_task k JOIN biz_teacher_tool t ON FIND_IN_SET(k.task_code, t.task_tags) > 0 WHERE k.status='0' AND k.del_flag='0' AND t.status='0' AND t.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c ON c.category_id=r.category_id WHERE r.tool_id=t.tool_id AND c.status='0' AND c.del_flag='0' ) GROUP BY k.task_id, k.task_code, k.task_name, k.description, k.sort_order ORDER BY k.sort_order, k.task_id

SELECT m.term_id, m.term, m.tool_id, m.sort_order FROM biz_teacher_tool_term m JOIN biz_teacher_tool t ON t.tool_id=m.tool_id WHERE t.status='0' AND t.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c ON c.category_id=r.category_id WHERE r.tool_id=t.tool_id AND c.status='0' AND c.del_flag='0' ) ORDER BY m.tool_id, m.sort_order, m.term_id
SELECT task_code, task_name, description, sort_order, status, del_flag, 0 AS tool_count FROM biz_teacher_tool_task WHERE del_flag='0' AND status='0' ORDER BY sort_order, task_id
SELECT task_code, task_name, description, sort_order, status, del_flag, 0 AS tool_count FROM biz_teacher_tool_task WHERE del_flag='0' ORDER BY sort_order, task_id

mapper.update: UPDATE biz_teacher_tool_category SET category_code=#{categoryCode}, category_name=#{categoryName}, description=#{description}, icon=#{icon}, section_level=#{sectionLevel}, default_expanded=#{defaultExpanded}, preview_limit=#{previewLimit}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=NOW() WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND del_flag='0'

SELECT t.*, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c2.category_name ORDER BY c2.sort_order, c2.category_id SEPARATOR '、') FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel r2 JOIN biz_teacher_tool_category c2 ON c2.category_id=r2.category_id WHERE r2.tool_id=t.tool_id AND c2.status='0' AND c2.del_flag='0') AS category_name_text, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(k2.task_name ORDER BY k2.sort_order, k2.task_id SEPARATOR '、') FROM biz_teacher_tool_task k2 WHERE FIND_IN_SET(k2.task_code, t.task_tags) > 0 AND k2.del_flag='0' AND k2.status='0') AS task_name_text FROM biz_teacher_tool t WHERE t.del_flag=#{delFlag}
AND (t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR t.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR t.aliases LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_teacher_tool_category_rel fr WHERE fr.tool_id=t.tool_id AND fr.category_id=#{categoryId})
AND t.source_type=#{sourceType} AND t.status=#{status} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.tool_id
